grammar.label: concession — even though, even if, whereas
grammar.form: even though + fact; even if + possibility
grammar.meaning: an unexpected contrast, and a contrast that holds either way

explanation.en: 'Even though' introduces a fact: 'Even though it rained, we went.' 'Even if' introduces a possibility: 'Even if it rains, we will go.' 'Whereas' sets two facts side by side.
explanation.uz: 'even though' — haqiqiy fakt: 'Even though it rained, we went.' 'even if' — ehtimol: 'Even if it rains, we will go.' 'whereas' ikki faktni yonma-yon qo'yadi.

grammar.positive_example: Even if the price rises, we will keep the order.
grammar.negative_example: Even if the price rose yesterday, we will keep the order.

l1_notes.uz: 'even though' fakt, 'even if' faraz — ikkalasi ham o'zbekcha '-sa ham' bilan beriladi.

grammar.label: quantifiers with of — each, either, neither, none
grammar.meaning: picking out members of a known group

explanation.en: 'Of' is needed before a determiner or pronoun: 'each of the students', not 'each of students'. 'Neither' takes a singular verb in careful English.
explanation.uz: Aniqlovchi yoki olmoshdan oldin 'of' shart: 'each of the students', 'each of students' EMAS. Ehtiyotkor uslubda 'neither' birlik fe'l oladi.

grammar.positive_example: Neither of the answers is correct.

l1_notes.uz: 'of' tushib qolishi eng keng tarqalgan xato.
